d:
Congress Rally : rajdhani dilli men kangres ki 'vot bachao, desh bachao' raili ko lekar siyasi halchal tej ho gaee hai. kal ramlila maidan men aayojit hone vali is raili men I.N.D.I.A. blok ke neta bhi shamil honge. raili men bhag lene ke lie bihar se bhi kangres aur vipakshi dalon ke karyakarta dilli ravana ho rahe hain.
Vahin, raili se pahle NDA aur RJD ke bich jubani jang tej ho gaee hai. NDA ne vipaksh par arajakta phailane ka aarop lagaya hai, jabki RJD ne palatvar karte hue BJP par nishana sadha hai.
